intro.text: Wayne's uncle, a miner who lived with Wayne and his mother in their one-window house beside the mine in Tinweight Settlement.

items.text: Wayne felt Gregr cared nothing for him or his mother, and hinted that he was abusive. Gregr died in a mining accident before 319 PC, crushed by falling rock. Afterwards Wayne would sometimes kick the table Gregr had built for their nearly bare home, to spite him in case he was watching.
